items.item:
1. The owner opens a session while the agent replaces its request; granting
   with the old version is refused.
   Shows A12-1, A12-2. [witness: verification:registry_a12_grant_with_replaced_request_version_refused]
statements:
```text
owner_action(x, stated v) with v != version(x) => refused, x unchanged   -- A12-1
accepted change of x other than its end => version(x)' = version(x) + 1   -- A12-2
```

verdicts.why: The replacement request is accepted and its access version is checked to increase by exactly one, asserting A12-2. A direct grant using the previously seen version is checked for the stale refusal code and stage, while both the externally read access state and persisted session row are checked unchanged, asserting A12-1.
